events.title: Keep Farming Aura joins Steam Next Fest — play the free demo!
events.summary: Farm Aura with us during Steam Next Fest! Keep Farming Aura is taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19–26, and the free demo is ready to play! Start small, farm Aura, unlock upgrades, attract a crowd, and build your Crew in an active 3D incremental game where every move helps turn you into an Aura legend. events.title: Demo 0.6.5 — Animated HUD and experience improvements
events.summary: Added HUD animations for upgrades, farming, Crew, audience and aura gains, with states reflecting activity and purchase availability. Improved special and iconic move minigame button responsiveness, with hover and input feedback. Adjusted the placement of the lower HUD elements. Character customization now unlocks alongside upgrades. Fixed clicks on the customization rotation arrows and confirm and cancel buttons. Real participants take priority over bots and ignored accounts in chat and speech

events.title: Demo 0.6.4.4 — Customization improvements and fixes
events.summary: You can now choose item models and colors separately in character customization. Improved navigation and appearance option selection. Restored female character customization options. Refined character faces and the fit of glasses. Added glasses variants with dark and mirrored lenses. Fixed the exit transition for radio messages.

events.title: Demo 0.6.4.3 — More Twitch interaction and fixes
events.summary: Increased aura rewards from Twitch messages and adjusted the reward cooldown for Crew members. Improved chat bubble presentation and the animation of the aura contribution counter. Fixed an issue that could stop radio messages from appearing. The Crew now interrupts its moves and reacts when the player fails. Fixed iconic move opportunities appearing during the double special move. Fixed the Continue button after reaching the demo progression limit.

events.title: Demo 0.6.4.2 — Sound and chat bubble fixes
events.summary: Fixed the sound for the double special move. Improved the presentation of Twitch chat message bubbles.

events.title: Demo 0.6.4 — More Twitch interaction and special move improvements
events.summary: Gameplay The second chance of a double special now starts immediately. Added a visual and sound cue to signal the second chance. Twitch Integration Messages containing aura or 67 now grant Aura directly, in addition to the existing temporary production bonus. Added a HUD counter to track Aura generated by chat. Added floating numbers to show message rewards. Added support for emotes in messages shown in character bubbles and on the radio. Viewer assignment between the Crew and the Crowd now cons

events.title: Demo 0.6.3 — A celebration for maxing out the demo
events.summary: A new celebration panel appears when every available demo upgrade reaches its maximum level, with the Aura Championship emblem, animation and sound. It appears only once per save. Fixed the requirements that could prevent the crew’s special move and iconic move copying upgrades from appearing. Iconic move copying also requires the iconic move chance upgrade. events.summary: Improvements to Twitch integration: Viewer names stay linked to their characters. Messages from viewers in the crowd or crew appear above their own characters. The radio shows messages from viewers who do not yet have a character. Send aura or 67 in chat to double your character’s aura production for 2.5 seconds. events.title: The Keep Farming Aura demo is out. Come give it a go!
events.summary: Hey everyone! The Keep Farming Aura demo is live on Steam! You can finally jump in and start farming some aura. We’ve been looking forward to getting it into your hands. Download it, give it a go, and let us know how it went. What made you laugh? What felt off? Found a bug? Tell us in the discussions here on Steam. We’ll be reading. If you had fun, adding the full game to your wishlist helps us a lot. Thanks for being here and trying out what we’re making. See you in the demo! The Giant Warrior
